2eba1b4d141a4c2337d4.headline: Bankunan Najeriya na shirin rage kudaden dizel don gudanar da ayyuka
2eba1b4d141a4c2337d4.dek: Katsewar wutar lantarki na iya dakatar da harkokin banki, kuma bankunan na neman hanyoyin rage dogaro ga injinan janareta masu amfani da dizel.
2eba1b4d141a4c2337d4.why: Bankunan da suka rage dogaro ga dizel dole su ci gaba da tafiyar da na'urorin ATM da tsarin sadarwa na zamani duk da akwai katsewar wutar lantarki.
paragraphs: Bankunan Najeriya na dogara da wutar lantarki mara katsewa wajen sarrafa na'urorin bada kuɗi na ATM, da rassa, da tsarin banki na zamani, da kuma cibiyoyin tattara bayanai, kamar yadda wani rahoton Nairametrics da aka buga a 24 ga Nuwamba 2026 ya nuna. Rahoton ya ce amfani da dizel wani nauyi ne na kudi da bankunan za su iya ragewa yayin da suke ci gaba da sarrafa wadannan ayyuka.

Ya ce katsewar wutar lantarki na iya haifar da dakatarwar mu'amala, da tasgaro a ayyuka, da kuma lalata sunan kamfani a fadin fannin. Bankunan sun dogara da dizel tsawon shekaru domin tafiyar da manyan abubuwan da suka shafi gudanarwa, inji rahoton, amma bai bayar da adadin abin da aka adana ba kuma bai ambaci sunan takamaiman banki da ke da wadannan shirye-shiryen ba.
Rahoton bai bayyana wani sabon mataki ko jadawalin lokaci na rage amfani da dizel ba.

22212c6826a54eb4a7c8.headline: Gwamnan Diffa ya bayyana dalilin korar al'ummar Mohamid a Nijar
22212c6826a54eb4a7c8.dek: Mahamadou Ibrahim Bagadoma ya banbanta tsakanin rukunin da Larabawan Nijar sannan ya bukaci a yi bayyananniyar tattaunawa don kare zaman lafiyar al'umma.
22212c6826a54eb4a7c8.why: Mazauna Mohamid a Diffa su ne rukunin da ke karkashin tsarin korar da gwamnati ta yi, wanda Bagadoma ya tattauna a taron jama'a.
paragraphs: Gwamnan yankin Diffa, Mahamadou Ibrahim Bagadoma, ya gudanar da taron wayar da kan jama'a a ranar Talata, 24 ga Nuwamba, game da matakin gwamnati na korar al'ummar Mohamid daga Nijar. An gudanar da taron ne a birnin Diffa kuma ya hada da wakilan kungiyoyin sana'o'i na yankin da hukumomin gwamnati.

Bagadoma ya ce an shirya taron ne domin yi karin haske kan tsarin da hukumomi suka dauka da kuma magance kura-kuran bayanan da ke yawo a kafafen sada zumunta. Ya banbanta tsakanin al'ummar Mohamid, wacce ya bayyana a matsayin ’yan kasashen waje, da Larabawan Nijar, wadanda ya ce sun dade da kafuwa a kasar kuma ba su shafi wannan matakin ba.

Gwamnan ya ce bayanin nasa ya shafi asalin al'ummar Mohamid, da isowarsu Nijar, da koke-koke kan su, da matakan da hukumomin kasa suka dauka, da kuma ma'anar matakin gwamnati. Ya yi kira da a yi sadarwa ta gaskiya don hana rudani da rikici a yankin.

15046a30a2c09890b262.headline: Nijar ta gabatar da ayyuka 50 ga masu zuba jari a taron Yamai
15046a30a2c09890b262.dek: Wannan taro na kwanaki uku ya jawo hankalin masu zuba jari 300 daga kasashe 30 kuma yana niyyar kulla yarjejeniyoyin da suka kai CFA biliyan 5,500.
15046a30a2c09890b262.why: Masu zuba jari da suka halarci taron daga kasashe 30 za su duba ayyuka 50 a fannoni 13, tare da nufin cimma yarjejeniyoyin CFA biliyan 5,500.
paragraphs: Nijar ta bude taron kasa da kasa na farko kan Zuba Jari a Nijar a birnin Yamai a ranar Talata, inda ya haɗa mutane sama da 1,000, ciki har da masu zuba jari 300 daga kasashe 30. Ma'aikatar kasuwanci da masana'antu tare da hukumar inganta zuba jari ta kasa ce suka shirya taron, wanda zai dore har zuwa 26 ga Nuwamba.

Firaminista Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine ne ya bude taron a madadin Shugaba Abdourahamane Tiani. Masu shirya taron na da niyyar gabatar da jerin ayyuka 50 da za a iya sanyawa jari a fannoni 13 na zuba jari, tare da sanya ran cimma yarjejeniyoyin da suka kai CFA biliyan 5,500.

Bigon taron shi ne gina kawancen dabarun kasuwanci domin samun wadata da kuma martabar tattalin arziki mai dorewa. Manufarsa da aka bayyana ita ce inganta zuba jari na cikin gida da na waje ta hanyar wadannan kawance.

d8fc5376a5a7c7b4c33e.headline: Gwamnan Diffa ya isar da sakon shugaban kasa a tunawa da Tandja
d8fc5376a5a7c7b4c33e.dek: Hukuma da mazauna garin sun taru a Mainé-Soroa domin addu'o'in cika shekaru shida da rasuwar tsohon shugaban kasar ta Nijar.
d8fc5376a5a7c7b4c33e.why: Gwamnan ya isar da gaisuwa da sakon jaje daga shugaban kasa ga iyalan Tandja da mazauna Mainé-Soroa yayin bikin tunawa da shi.
paragraphs: Hukuma da mazauna garin sun taru a gidan tsohon Shugaban Nijar Mamadou Tandja dake Mainé-Soroa a yankin Diffa a ranar Talata don yin addu'o'in tunawa da cika shekaru shida da rasuwarsa. Babban basaraken garin Mainé-Soroa, Abdou Katiellou Katiella Gasso, ne ya jagoranci wannan biki.

Gwamnan Diffa Mahamadou Ibrahim Bagadoma ya halarci taron a madadin Shugaba Abdourahamane Tiani, inda ya isar da gaisuwa da jaje ga iyalan Tandja da mazauna garin. Wadanda suka halarci taron sun karanta Alkur'ani mai girma gaba daya, da Fatiha, sannan sun yi addu'a ga Tandja, da zaman lafiyar al'umma da tsaro a Nijar, da Burkina Faso, da Mali, da kuma dakarun da suka rasu yayin kare kasarsu.
Bayan addu'o'in, jami'ai sun taru a kabarinsu Tandja. Bagadoma ya ce bikin ya nuna cewa akwai nauyi na tunawa da fitattun mutanen da suka tsara tarihin siyasa da gwamnati na Nijar.

4e98e7973b6937e0d62b.headline: Yan sandan Delta na binciken rikicin siyasa yayin da aka sanya dokar ta baci a Ughelli North
4e98e7973b6937e0d62b.dek: ‘Yan sanda sun ba da rahoton mutuwar mutane shida da samun raunuka da dama a wani taron yakin neman zabe, yayin da gwamnatin jihar ta kakaba dokar hana fitowa dare a fadin yankin kananan hukumomin.
4e98e7973b6937e0d62b.why: Mazauna Ughelli North dole ne su kiyaye dokar hana fitowa daga karfe 6 na yamma zuwa karfe 6 na safe kullum har sai an sanar da wani sabon mataki yayin da ‘yan sanda ke binciken rikicin.
paragraphs: Rundunar ‘yan sandan Najeriya ta ce mutane shida ne suka mutu sannan wasu da dama suka jikkata yayin wani taron yakin neman zabe a yankin al'ummar Uduere da ke Karamar Hukumar Ughelli North ta Jihar Delta. Gwamnatin Jihar Delta ta sanya dokar hana fitowa daga karfe 6 na yamma zuwa karfe 6 na safe kullum a fadin yankin har sai an sanar da wani sabon mataki.

Kakakin ‘yan sanda Ani Iniedu ya ce binciken farko ya nuna cewa mutane shida ne suka mutu, yayin da za a gudanar da bincike don tabbatar da adadin wadanda suka jikkata da kuma gano abin da ya faru. Babban Inspector Janar na ‘Yan Sanda Olatunji Disu ya umarci kwamishinan ‘yan sandan Delta da ya binciki yadda lamarin ya faru, da gano wadanda ke da hannu, da kuma duba matakan jami'an tsaro da kuma yadda aka tura su wajen taron.

‘Yan sandan sun ce rundunar jihar na aiwatar da dokar hana fitowa kuma ta kara kaimu wajen daukar matakan tsaro. Binciken ya biyo koke ne daga tawagar yakin neman zaben tsohon mataimakin shugaban majalisar dattawa Ovie Omo-Agege cewa ‘yan bindiga sun kai hari kan tawagarsa; tawagar ta bayar da rahoton mutuwar mutane hudu.

9b3efabad35cfedb7ec0.headline: Kotun Abuja ta datse N135.5 biliyan da ke da alaka da Kungiyar Gwamnoni
9b3efabad35cfedb7ec0.dek: Umurnin ya haramtawa kungiyar da bankuna 29 motsa kudaden yayin da kotun ke duba karar wani lauya a karkashin yarjejeniyar 2018.
9b3efabad35cfedb7ec0.why: Dole ne kungiyar NGF ta bar kudaden ba tare da an taba su ba, sannan bankuna 29 su bayar da rahoton bayanan asusu da adadin kudaden a cikin sa'o'i 48 da karbar umurnin.
paragraphs: Babban Kotun Birnin Tarayya Abuja ta datse N135.5 biliyan da ke da alaka da Kungiyar Gwamnonin Najeriya (NGF) a wani rikici kan kudaden diyya na Paris Club. Alkalin kotun O. C. Agbaza ne ya bayar da wannan umarni na rikon kwarya a ranar 19 ga Nuwamba, inda ya hana kungiyar cirewa ko tura kudaden tare da hana bankunan kasuwanci 29 gudanar da wani abu da kudaden NGF da ke hannunsu.

Umurnin ya biyo bayan rokon da lauya Ted Iseghohi-Edwards ya yi, wanda ya ce wata yarjejeniya ta 2018 ta bukaci NGF ta biya shi idan aka samu Gwamnatin Tarayya da laifin biyan kudaden ayyukansa. Alkalin ya umarci bankunan da su bayyana a cikin sa'o'i 48 da karbar sammacin ko suna da asusun da ke dauke da kudaden da ake takaddama a kansu, ciki har da adadin kudaden da kudaden da aka yi amfani da su.

Iseghohi-Edwards ya ce ya nemi a biya shi kudin daga kungiyar a cikin wata wasika mai dauke da kwanan wata ta 8 ga Oktoba, 2026. Adadin kudin ya yi daidai da dala miliyan 100 a kan musayar kudin da aka bayyana a rahoton kotun.

6998bef1d70c943856e6.headline: Tinubu ya yi alƙawarin magance matsalar ruwa da wuta
6998bef1d70c943856e6.dek: Shugaban Najeriya ya ce ruwa ya ɗauke yayin da yake aske gemu a fadar Aso Villa, inda kuma yake fuskantar katsewar wutar lantarki.
6998bef1d70c943856e6.why: Dole ne yanzu shugaban ya magance matsalolin ruwa da wuta da ya ce suna shafar fadar da ma sauran ƴan Najeriya na yau da kullum.
paragraphs: Shugaba Bola Tinubu ya ce an samu katsewar ruwa da wutar lantarki a fadar Aso Villa, wato ofishi da wurin zama na shugaban ƙasa da ke Abuja, bayan ruwan ya ɗauke yayin da yake aske gemu a can maƙon jiya. Ya ce zai magance matsalolin wutar lantarki a ƙasar.

Tinubu ya yi magana ne a ranar Lahadi a wani taron addu'a da danginsa suka shirya a Legas, inda ya bayyana cewa ruwa ya katse a fadar. Ya danganta wutar lantarki, ruwa da cigaba, kuma ya ce gwamnatinsa za ta gyara matsalolin.
Tinubu na neman sake tsayawa takara a watan Janairu mai zuwa kuma ya yi alƙawarin magance matsalolin wutar lantarki yayin yaƙin neman zaɓe na shekarar 2023.

289a791695d69777ffdf.headline: Banka ta kafa mafi ƙarancin farashin masara a naira 350,000
289a791695d69777ffdf.dek: Banka ta Noma (BOA) ta ce shisshinsinta na naira biliyan 200 wani yanki ne na wani babban shiri da ya tara kusan naira biliyan 500 ga manoma.
289a791695d69777ffdf.why: Manoman masara da suka ga farashi ya faɗi zuwa naira 140,000 a kowace tan za a biya su bisa mafi ƙarancin farashi na naira 350,000, kuma tallafin bankin ya riga ya isa ga manoma sama da 500,000.
paragraphs: Manoman da faduwar farashin amfanin gona ta shafa za su ci gajiyar tallafin naira biliyan 200 daga Bankin Noma (BOA), kamar yadda manajan daraktan bankin, Ayodeji Sontinrin, ya bayyana a taron Bunkasa da Ci gaban Ƙasa na 2026 da aka gudanar a Abuja a ranar Alhamis. Farashin masara ya faɗi daga kusan naira 680,000 zuwa naira 140,000 a kowace tan, kuma tallafin farashin na bankin na da nufin kafa mafi ƙarancin farashi na naira 350,000 a kowace tan.

Sontinrin ya ce bankin ya tara kusan naira biliyan 500 domin tallafawa kananan manoma sama da 500,000 a jihohi 16, ciki har da mata sama da 70,000 da suka amfana da tallafin noma na naira biliyan 250 da aka ware domin ƙananan manoma. Wannan shiri ya raba manyan jakunkunan takin zamani sama da miliyan 2.5 da kuma jakunkunan ingantattun iri 300,000, wadanda ya ce za su iya ɗaga amfanin hatsi daga kusan tan ɗaya zuwa tan biyar a kowace hekta a ƙarƙashin yanayi mai kyau.

Haka kuma ana bai wa manoma tirektococi 2,000 a kan raguwar kashi 40%, tare da na'urorin ban ruwa masu amfani da rana da kuma kekuna masu maturƙa masu ɗaukar kaya da ke amfani da wuta. Bugu da ƙari, bankin na tallafawa noman shinkafa da alkama na rani da kuma ba da tallafin kuɗi da aka fi mayar da hankali kan mata da matasa.
